author: The Spiffing Brit
description:
Well 2026 has just begun and the most unexpected video game comeback has just released into early access! Its Hytale! Originally from the team that brought you the hypixel minecraft server, then the team that was purchased by riot games and now just someone named simon we have a brand new open world survival sandbox. Or minecraft 2.0 as some people have called it but realistically as the creators themselves will say this is VERY early access and so that leaves me asking myself. Is Hytale A Perfectly Balanced Game? 


So I decided to dive into the world of hytale and dig around for some exploits and after half a day of playing I have created this youtube video to show off the most fun hytale glitches, bugs and exploits that I could find. Of course now that the game has seen over 2.8 million players it makes sense that some of you might already own the game and want to use these funky game mechanics to your advantage and to have funny moments with friends so here you go have some fun wi
title: Does Hytale Have Glitches? - Hytale A Perfectly Balanced Game With No Exploits
